submitted.rationale: Of the 5 compositions measured, Sb 0.249 had the highest EQE (0.00065%). The nearby samples were slightly lower (Sb 0.198: 0.00062%; Sb 0.303: 0.00054%), so the peak lies around Sb 0.2-0.3, which is near Bi3SbO7. XRD shows FTO substrate peaks plus a Bi-rich phase that gets weaker as Sb increases. That phase is weak by Sb 0.38. The Bi-rich phase was not firmly identified: its best matches were Bi2O3 (mp-23262, 0.69) and Bi3SbO7 (mp-30304, 0.63). All EQE values are very low, and the differences between the top samples are small.
